result.brief: 提出ΔRepresentation框架，通过几何监督的BaseAnatomy与反事实增量ΔPhenotype模块学习医学VLM的病理表型视觉表征，使同表型增量在表征空间聚类。
result.reason: Proposes geometry-supervised and counterfactual incremental visual representation learning for medical VLMs, structuring phenotype representations—directly a visual representation learning contribution.
